entities._light_comment: v0.17 R2 night-readability light. VISUAL-LOG named `hut_hearth_ash`; NOT used -- that prop is "The Cold Hearth" whose toast says the ash has been cold for years. The scrap is what this room says glows.
entities.skill_hint_toast: The scrap hums under the dust, and not the way dust hums.
entities.locked_toast: A palm-sized shard of grey stone on the shelf, cut along one edge with marks you cannot read.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — The shard is one link of a boundary that used to ring the whole thicket. It still pulls, faintly, along the exact line the deer refuse to cross. It was drawn to keep something in, and it has been failing at that for a very long time.

entities.observe: A shard of grey stone on the shelf, set down carefully by someone who meant to come back for it.
A row of stoppered jars along the top shelf, their labels faded to a suggestion.
entities.toast: Every stopper is waxed and every jar is still full. Whoever kept this house left it ready and never came back for it.

entities.observe: A rack of bundled stems, dried long past any use.
entities.toast: Yarrow, mostly, and a great deal of it. Somebody kept this place stocked for a house they intended to come back to.

entities.observe: Cold ash banked neatly against the back of the hearth.
entities.toast: The ash is banked the way you bank a fire you mean to wake in the morning. It has been cold for years.

entities.observe: One shutter, latched, with daylight coming through the slats in bars.
entities.toast: Latched from the inside, and the hut was shut when you found it. You decide not to work that through any further today.
